intent.raw: Explain and add to the design all branches of the ontology and how they interact with the product and client work.
intent.objective: Run the canonical refine loop with one branch-evidence-mapper subagent to enumerate every ontology branch (from ontology-vault and the GoldenQuill ontology DAG), define each, and map each to the four product layers and to client work for both verticals, including cross-branch bridge interactions and drift detection.
intent.operator_sentence: Add the ontology branches and their product/client interactions to the design.

technique_overlays.trigger: The ontology branch taxonomy and its interactions with product layers and client work are the hidden structure to surface.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: ONTOLOGY-BRANCHES.md emits a concrete branch × product-layer × client-work mapping, each branch traced to a cited source path or marked hypothesis.

technique_overlays.trigger: The ontology-vault branch model and GoldenQuill ontology DAG branches are material prior work.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Reuse ontology-vault SKILL/README + GoldenQuill ontology DAG synthesis; dedup against DAG-AND-METRICS.md; record residue.

route_menu.context_hint: Single profile: x-ray the branch structure + memory reuse of the two branch sources.

items.label: X-ray the branches
items.description: Surface every branch and map to product layers + client work.

items.label: Business/system only
items.description: Cover only ontology-vault's two branches; ignores GoldenQuill's operational + meaning branches.

steps.name: Context Builder evidence baseline
stop_conditions: Block if the ontology-vault and GoldenQuill ontology DAG sources cannot be read.

steps.name: Invoke Define the branch explanation
stop_conditions: Flag if a done-criterion is unaddressed.

steps.name: Research decision
stop_conditions: Ask before any external pass if a named external gap appears.

steps.name: Distill: map branches to layers and client work
stop_conditions: Block if a branch cannot trace to a cited source or be marked hypothesis.

steps.name: Invoke Redesign to ONTOLOGY-BRANCHES.md
stop_conditions: Block if the artifact lacks per-branch definitions, product-layer map, and client-work map.

steps.name: Interrogation refine-design-review
stop_conditions: Flag any branch missing a layer or client-work mapping.

steps.name: Distill repair
stop_conditions: Block if a flagged gap cannot be repaired or named as residue.

steps.name: Invoke Plan deltas
stop_conditions: Non-executed; flag if deltas are not mapped to existing artifacts.

steps.name: Final Interrogation and Refine synthesis
stop_conditions: Block if the done-criteria are not concretely satisfied.

subagent_strategy.trigger: The canonical branch set spans two sources (ontology-vault business/system/bridge + GoldenQuill ontology DAG meaning/system/operational/bridge) and must be mapped to product layers and client work.
subagent_strategy.explanation: A branch-evidence-mapper reads both branch sources and returns a source-true branch taxonomy with its product-layer and client-work mapping, so the design enumerates real branches rather than invented ones.
context: ontology-vault is branch-aware (business ↔ system, bridge edges, conventions).
GoldenQuill's ontology DAG (master) used meaning / system / operational / bridge branches.

roles.purpose: Read ontology-vault + GoldenQuill ontology DAG and return each branch's definition, product-layer touchpoints, and client-work manifestation.

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: Run one branch-evidence-mapper subagent to ground the ontology branch taxonomy and its product/client mapping?

boundaries.contract: ontology-vault skill definitions and GoldenQuill ontology DAG docs are read-only branch evidence cited but not modified.
No external research without operator confirmation; default no-research/local-first.

promotion_splits.target: canonical Arcanum ontology vocabulary or client-facing collateral
promotion_splits.rule: requires owner review and a separate promotion route

gates.condition: Every runtime-backed stage names a canonical capability handle.
Every branch traces to a cited ontology-vault or GoldenQuill source path, or is marked hypothesis.
Each branch has a product-layer mapping and a client-work mapping; cross-branch bridge interactions are explained.
Source skill definitions and GoldenQuill docs are read-only; this run must not modify them.
The approved branch-evidence-mapper returns its mapping before parent synthesis.
Outputs are candidates; no canonical promotion, no pricing/contracts/named clients.
RESULT.md is synthesized from stage artifacts and the subagent receipt and confirms the done-criteria.

promotion_guardrails: ontology-vault skill definitions and GoldenQuill ontology DAG docs are read-only evidence.
ONTOLOGY-BRANCHES.md is a candidate design, not a built system.
No canonical Arcanum promotion; no pricing/contracts/named clients.
